scripts.push: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm build && clasp push -u ${CLASP_USER:?CLASP_USER is not set} --force
scripts.deploy: pnpm run version:bump && clasp deploy -u ${CLASP_USER:?CLASP_USER is not set}
scripts.redeploy: pnpm run version:bump && pnpm build && clasp push -u ${CLASP_USER:?CLASP_USER is not set} --force && clasp redeploy -u ${CLASP_USER:?CLASP_USER is not set} ${DEPLOYMENT_ID:?DEPLOYMENT_ID is not set}
